The Aerobridge model

One course layer. One country layer.

Core aviation subjects travel across borders. Licensing procedures and exams do not. Aerobridge keeps course content and country guidance separate, so you can see which rules apply.

01 / CORE

ICAO-aligned knowledge

Communication, rules of the air, aircraft knowledge, navigation, performance and operations.

02 / COUNTRY

Authority references

Licensing, medical, exam and practical standards tracked to the relevant source and revision.

03 / PATH

Your training route

The program, country, authority and licence goal determine what you should study next.

Why it exists

Training should connect the rulebook to the real flight.

Theory becomes useful when it stays connected to the regulator, the cockpit and the language used on frequency. Aerobridge is built around that connection.
